before: Preregistered before the one-shot reopening of any TEST parent. This specification provides no authorization to open data.
sources: Only an explicitly authorized all-ten frozen TEST projection. Input for each beta is V[8192,8,27], E[8192,8,386], parent[8192] in permanent TEST roster order, eight disjoint cavity anchors per parent. A parent, not an anchor, is the uncertainty unit. No old study assessment, tuning or adaptive draw. Compare frozen refit seed6101 and its six fixed primary-seed critic controls at the elected depth. Other fixed seeds 6102-5 descriptive only.
groups: Exactly 8192 groups of 8 distinct parents for each of uniform and matched (candidate marginal symmetric, all positions positives). No cross-beta groups. Pilot iid law: uniform sampled parent subset and one uniform anchor; matched S by supported anchor mass then eight uniformly sampled distinct parents in that S, then uniform eligible anchor. PCG64([731903,beta_index,0_or_1]); all models/laws share a single frozen group realization when comparable. No assumption that unconditional and conditional groups coincide. Record SHA256 int64-LE opportunity indices, exact eligible/drawn parents and anchors, min/max actual parent draws. The primary code rate/entropy is computed separately over all 65536 TEST opportunities per beta, not just repeated evaluation groups.
scores: Finite-candidate predictive log gain in nats vs uniform candidates. For each frozen model each law gives deployed hard argmax and exact posterior expectation of candidate log-probability, always post normalization/log. Common = .5*(uniform+matched). Per-beta and all-ten equal-beta proper gain, fixed single primary seed minus the paired frozen control; also absolute score. No nominal two-bit claim for collapsed codes. Never train or recalibrate critic on TEST.
uncertainty: Use 16 balanced whole-parent blocks, PCG64([731903,beta_index,323]). For each block drop every group containing any of its candidates; calculate the paired hard/soft differences on the common surviving groups. Jackknife variance=(15/16)*sum_j(theta_minus_j-mean_deleted)^2. Per-beta t15, fixed ten-temperature macro variance=sum(V_b)/100, Welch-Satterthwaite df=(sum V_b)^2/sum(V_b^2/15). CIs conditional on this presampled MC evaluation. Exploratory individual code frequencies and realized seed spread are not independent replicates. Primary six common-hard macro comparisons to the fixed maps use Bonferroni; simultaneous 60-way intervals for ten individual-beta by six fixed-control comparisons. No claiming meaningful gain from a chance favorable seed, law, temperature, or table cell. Beta zero finite-composition control explicit; not unseen-temperature transfer.
controls: Run the numerical scorer on a finite planted alphabet with disjoint generated pseudo-parents, 8 perfect replicate anchors per parent, correlation .6 in 9 fake strata and 0 in the first, exactly calibrated frozen hard-X -> shell-Y oracle critic; zero-score fixed critics. No assessment outcome needed to verify implementation.
